text:
Maria Chen: Quick proposal — tighten TLS across regions. Aim: TLS1.3 minimum for client-facing endpoints; for TLS1.2 only allow modern ECDHE suites, drop RSA key-exchange and old CBC modes.
Ajay Patel: +1 in principle. do we have telemetry on which customers still use TLS1.2?
Maria Chen: Limited data — we see a tail in eu-west tcp handshake failures and a few internal services still on older nginx builds. I can pull SNI/handshake logs if useful.
Irene Gomez: curious about impact on our gateway LB vs service-mesh termination. some internal services rely on mTLS with client certs — will forcing TLS1.3 break those?
Sean O'Leary: TLS1.3 support in our envoy fleet is fine, but older sidecars (pre-2022) might need rebuild. we should canary-change mesh policy in staging before prod.
Kate Li: From compliance side, we should also record any TLS handshake failures into audit logs (not just LB metrics). want to trace client cert principals + SNI for failed handshakes for 30 days.
Maria Chen: Good call. That will help triage and also feed vulnerability teams if a client is using an unsafe library.
Ajay Patel: RBAC ask — sec-team needs temporary write to infra/tls-policies in the infra repo to create the canary terraform plan. Can we grant scoped perms via the repo's CODEOWNERS and a short-lived GitHub team?
Irene Gomez: prefer using a GitHub Actions workflow that requires 2 approvals from sec + sre instead of granting direct write perms. audit trail stays in PR history.
Maria Chen: Works for me. I'll open a PR with the policy change and mark it canary -> staging only.
sec-bot: vuln-alert: CVE-2025-2896 affecting some Java TLS stacks (renegotiation edge case). severity: medium. link: https://security.example.com/CVE-2025-2896
Sean O'Leary: noted — that CVE motivates removing TLS renegotiation support and forcing TLS1.3 where possible.
Kate Li: KMS question: if we rotate cert private keys frequently, should we store keys in cloud KMS (HSM-backed) or use Vault with HSM auto-unseal? any perf implications for TLS termination at scale?
Irene Gomez: We can keep private keys in cloud KMS and export ephemeral certs to edge proxies. For high-throughput LBs, prefer local keys on the appliance but with KMS-protected wrap keys and PKCS#11 integration.
Ajay Patel: Operationally — if we switch to HSM-backed keys, need to update our deploy playbooks. I'll add a checklist item: update Terraform provider + ensure policies allow the cert-rotation service principal to sign short-lived certs.
Maria Chen: Also add a probe to detect TLS version falls back to 1.2 from 1.3 in any region for >1% of requests — alert to eng-sre and sec.
opsbot: deploy-bot: applied tls-policy v1.1 to staging-lb-1. Command: `./infra apply -target=module.tls_policy -var='env=staging'` :rocket:
Kate Li: For audit logging, prefer structured logs: {event:"tls_handshake", outcome:"fail", sni:..., client_principal:..., reason:"cipher_mismatch"}. Keep raw handshake dumps for 7 days in secure bucket.
Maria Chen: I'll draft the nginx/envoy snippets and PR. snippets to include for reviewers:
```
# envoy listener TLS context (example)
common_tls_context:
  tls_params:
    tls_minimum_protocol_version: TLSv1_3
  tls_certificate_sds_secret_configs:
    - name: server_cert
      sds_config: { ... }
```
```
# nginx example for TLS1.2 fallback (if you must)
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
ssl_ciphers 'ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384';
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;
ssl_session_tickets off;
```
Irene Gomez: Can we add a quick smoke test to the PR that hits every regional LB with an automated client matrix (TLS1.3, TLS1.2 Java8, older Android)? want to avoid customer-facing regressions.
Maria Chen: yes — I'll wire up the matrix and include expected failure buckets in the PR description.
Ajay Patel: timeline?
Maria Chen: plan: PR today -> staging canary tomorrow -> monitor 48h -> roll to prod next week if no regressions.
Sean O'Leary: I'll prep a rollback playbook and a runbook entry for incident responders describing common handshake errors and recovery steps.
Kate Li: and I'll update compliance docs and record the RBAC change in the access log.
Maria Chen: thanks all. tagging @Irene for the Vault/KMS follow-up and @Ajay for the infra PR. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: ticket created: SEC-2025-1123 "TLS policy hardening rollout" assigned to Maria Chen.
